Description: Fairground fixed-IP payment gateway. One Lightsail VM and one attached static IPv4; no NAT gateway or load balancer.

BlueprintId.Description: Confirm availability with lightsail get-blueprints before creating the stack.

BundleId.Description: Confirm this is the $5 Linux IPv4 bundle with lightsail get-bundles before creating the stack.

KeyPairName.Description: Name of an existing Lightsail SSH key pair in the deployment region.

AdminCidr.Description: Your current administrator IPv4 as a /32. SSH is restricted to this address.

Properties.UserData:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2 unattended-upgrades
systemctl enable --now docker
install -d -m 700 /opt/fairground

StaticIPv4.Description: Optional reserved address for a separately hosted gateway. Confirm provider network requirements before provisioning.
